verifiers.name: verify-public-channels.py
verifiers.source:
import concurrent.futures
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import urllib.parse

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUT = ROOT / 'public-channels'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
VERSION = '1.166.0'
DESKTOP_ONLY = '--desktop-only' in sys.argv


def fetch(url, name, head=False):
    dest = OUT / name
    args = ['curl', '--fail', '--location', '--silent', '--show-error',
            '--connect-timeout', '15', '--max-time', '60', '--output', str(dest),
            '--write-out', '%{http_code}']
    if head:
        args.append('--head')
    result = subprocess.run(args + [url], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(f'{url}: {result.stderr.strip()}')
    return {'url': url, 'httpStatus': int(result.stdout),
            ('headersSha256' if head else 'sha256'): hashlib.sha256(dest.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            'body': dest.read_text()}


release = json.loads(subprocess.check_output([
    'gh', 'api', 'repos/limecloud/lime/releases/tags/v' + VERSION], text=True))
(OUT / 'github-release.json').write_text(json.dumps(release, indent=2) + '\n')
assert release['draft'] is False and release['prerelease'] is False
assert release['target_commitish'] == 'a7429000993b1516a3a58fd1b0e531f7974e13e5'
expected = {'lime-1.166.0-full.nupkg', 'Lime-1.166.0.Setup.exe',
            'Lime-darwin-arm64-1.166.0.zip', 'Lime-darwin-x64-1.166.0.zip',
            'macos-arm64-Lime-1.166.0.dmg', 'macos-x64-Lime-1.166.0.dmg',
            'macos-arm64-RELEASES.json', 'macos-x64-RELEASES.json', 'RELEASES',
            'lime-npm-1.166.0.tgz',
            *[f'lime-npm-{p}-1.166.0.tgz' for p in
              ['darwin-arm64', 'darwin-x64', 'linux-x64', 'win32-x64']]}
assets = {a['name']: a for a in release['assets']}
if DESKTOP_ONLY:
    expected = {name for name in expected if not name.startswith('lime-npm-')}
observed = {name for name in assets if not (DESKTOP_ONLY and name.startswith('lime-npm-'))}
assert observed == expected, {'missing': sorted(expected-observed),
                                 'unexpected': sorted(set(assets)-expected)}
assert all(a['state'] == 'uploaded' and a['size'] > 0 for a in assets.values())


def verify_mac(platform, asset_name):
    artifact = fetch(assets[asset_name]['browser_download_url'], asset_name)
    feed = json.loads(artifact['body'])
    assert feed['currentRelease'] == VERSION
    update = next(r['updateTo'] for r in feed['releases'] if r['version'] == VERSION)
    parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(update['url'])
    base = f'{parsed.scheme}://{parsed.netloc}'
    public = fetch(base + '/lime/stable/' + platform + '/RELEASES.json', platform + '-feed.json')
    public_feed = json.loads(public.pop('body'))
    assert public_feed['currentRelease'] == VERSION
    actual = next(r['updateTo'] for r in public_feed['releases'] if r['version'] == VERSION)
    assert actual['url'] == update['url']
    download = fetch(actual['url'], platform + '-artifact-head.txt', head=True)
    download.pop('body')
    return {'platform': platform, 'base': base, 'feed': public, 'download': download}


with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
    feeds = list(pool.map(lambda args: verify_mac(*args), [
        ('darwin-arm64', 'macos-arm64-RELEASES.json'),
        ('darwin-x64', 'macos-x64-RELEASES.json')]))
assert feeds[0]['base'] == feeds[1]['base']
base = feeds[0]['base']
windows_artifact = fetch(assets['RELEASES']['browser_download_url'], 'github-RELEASES')
windows = fetch(base + '/lime/stable/win32-x64/RELEASES', 'win32-x64-feed')
assert windows.pop('body').strip() == windows_artifact['body'].strip()
assert 'lime-1.166.0-full.nupkg' in windows_artifact['body']
windows_download = fetch(base + '/lime/stable/win32-x64/lime-1.166.0-full.nupkg',
                         'win32-x64-artifact-head.txt', head=True)
windows_download.pop('body')
feeds.append({'platform': 'win32-x64', 'base': base, 'feed': windows,
              'download': windows_download})


def verify_npm(platform):
    name = '@limecloud/lime' + (('-' + platform) if platform else '')
    version = VERSION + (('-' + platform) if platform else '')
    url = 'https://registry.npmjs.org/' + urllib.parse.quote(name, safe='@').replace('%2F', '%2f')
    response = fetch(url, 'npm-' + (platform or 'root') + '.json')
    packument = json.loads(response.pop('body'))
    manifest = packument['versions'][version]
    assert manifest['name'] == name and manifest['version'] == version
    assert manifest['dist']['integrity']
    if not platform:
        for p in ['darwin-arm64', 'darwin-x64', 'linux-x64', 'win32-x64']:
            assert manifest['optionalDependencies']['@limecloud/lime-' + p] == VERSION + '-' + p
    expected_tag = platform or 'latest'
    assert packument['dist-tags'][expected_tag] == version
    tarball = fetch(manifest['dist']['tarball'], 'npm-' + (platform or 'root') + '-tarball-head.txt', head=True)
    tarball.pop('body')
    return {'name': name, 'version': version, 'integrity': manifest['dist']['integrity'],
            'tarball': manifest['dist']['tarball'], 'httpStatus': response['httpStatus'],
            'distTag': expected_tag, 'tarballDownload': tarball}


npm = []
latest = {}
if not DESKTOP_ONLY:
    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=5) as pool:
        npm = list(pool.map(verify_npm, ['', 'darwin-arm64', 'darwin-x64', 'linux-x64', 'win32-x64']))
    root_packument = json.loads((OUT / 'npm-root.json').read_text())
    assert root_packument['dist-tags']['latest'] == VERSION
    latest = root_packument['versions'][VERSION]
summary = {'version': VERSION, 'recordedAt': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
           'github': {'url': release['html_url'], 'publishedAt': release['published_at'],
                      'targetCommit': release['target_commitish'],
                      'assets': [{'name': a['name'], 'size': a['size'], 'digest': a.get('digest')}
                                 for a in release['assets']]},
           'updater': feeds, 'npm': npm, 'npmLatest': latest.get('version')}
(OUT / ('desktop-summary.json' if DESKTOP_ONLY else 'summary.json')).write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(summary))

verifiers.source:
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import pathlib
import subprocess

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = ROOT.parent.parent
SOURCE = ROOT / 'source'
INSTALL = ROOT / 'npm-installed'
LOG = ROOT / 'published-npm-gate-b.log'
assert not (INSTALL / 'node_modules').exists(), 'Fresh public verification requires an unused dependency directory'
INSTALL.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
fixture_hashes = {}
for name in ['cli-gate-b.mjs', 'cli-exec-gate-b.mjs', 'cli-reasoning-gate-b.mjs',
             'cli-interrupt-gate-b.mjs', 'terminal-gate-binaries.mjs', 'terminal-gate-fixture.mjs']:
    relative = 'scripts/app-server/' + name
    expected = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'a7429000993b1516a3a58fd1b0e531f7974e13e5:' + relative], cwd=REPO)
    actual = (SOURCE / relative).read_bytes()
    assert actual == expected, 'Fixture source drift: ' + relative
    fixture_hashes[relative] = hashlib.sha256(actual).hexdigest()
with LOG.open('w') as log:
    command = ['npm', 'install', '--prefix', str(INSTALL), '--no-audit', '--no-fund',
               '--registry=https://registry.npmjs.org', '@limecloud/lime@1.166.0']
    result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    assert result.returncode == 0, f'npm install failed; see {LOG}'
    scope = INSTALL / 'node_modules/@limecloud'
    launcher = scope / 'lime/bin/lime.js'
    platform = scope / 'lime-darwin-arm64'
    payload = platform / 'vendor/aarch64-apple-darwin/bin'
    app_server = payload / 'app-server'
    manifests = [json.loads((scope / name / 'package.json').read_text())
                 for name in ['lime', 'lime-darwin-arm64']]
    assert manifests[0]['version'] == '1.166.0'
    assert manifests[1]['version'] == '1.166.0-darwin-arm64'
    version = subprocess.check_output(['node', str(launcher), '--version'], text=True).strip()
    assert '1.166.0' in version, version
    log.write('Registry installed launcher version: ' + version + '\n')
    log.flush()
    env = dict(os.environ, LIME_CLI_BIN=str(launcher), APP_SERVER_BIN=str(app_server),
               LIME_CLI_GATE_B_USE_SIBLING_APP_SERVER='1')
    gate = ['node', 'scripts/app-server/cli-gate-b.mjs']
    result = subprocess.run(gate, cwd=SOURCE, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    assert result.returncode == 0, f'published CLI Gate B failed; see {LOG}'

summary = {'version': '1.166.0', 'recordedAt': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
           'source': 'npm public registry exact published versions',
           'installPrefix': str(INSTALL), 'launcherVersion': version,
           'packages': [{'name': m['name'], 'version': m['version']} for m in manifests],
           'gateExitCode': result.returncode,
           'boundary': 'Installed npm launcher -> sibling packaged App Server -> real stdio JSON-RPC -> canonical projection and visible CLI output; controlled external backend, no live provider.',
           'fixtureSourceCommit': 'a7429000993b1516a3a58fd1b0e531f7974e13e5',
           'verifiedFixtureSourceHashes': fixture_hashes,
           'payload': {p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                       for p in [launcher, app_server, payload / 'lime']}}
(ROOT / 'published-npm-gate-b.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(summary))

qualifications: Fresh npm dependency directory; exact public package versions, no global install.
All expected assets and public metadata checked; HTTP 200 validates availability, not a full per-platform execution test.
Installed CLI execution on macOS arm64 only; controlled external backend plus runtime command shutdown fixtures.
No live provider, outer human TTY or TUI PTY claim.
